proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Lobbying Report
proposals.proponent: Walden Asset Management, joined by The Benedictine Sisters of Baltimore, The Benedictine Sisters of Pan de Vida and other organizations
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report, updated annually, disclosing company policies, lobbying and grassroots lobbying payments including direct and indirect lobbying and oversight decision-making.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Political Contributions Report
proposals.proponent: Clean Yield Asset Management, on behalf of John Fedor-Cunningham and David Fedor-Cunningham, with Benedictine Sisters of Mount St. Scholastica
proposals.topic_summary: Requests semiannual report on political contributions and expenditures, direct and indirect, including trade association and 501(c)(4) payments and recipients.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Gender Pay
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Eleanor Shorter, and Proxy Impact, on behalf of CB Wealth Generation LLC
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report by November 2017 on policies and goals to reduce the gender pay gap.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Charitable Contributions Report
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report on standards, rationale, personnel, and societal benefits of charitable contributions, with follow-up on use of funds.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding the Implementation of "Holy Land Principles"
proposals.proponent: Holy Land Principles, Inc. as lead filer, and Azzad Asset Management as co-filer
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to make all possible lawful efforts to implement the eight Holy Land Principles on equal employment opportunity in Israel/Palestine.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on "Fake News"
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of its clients Susanna L. Hoffs and Matthew Joseph Roach, Jr.
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report reviewing public policy issues of fake news and hate speech enabled by Google AdSense, including risks to democracy and free speech.
proposals.evidence: our Board of Directors does not believe that implementing this proposal would benefit our stockholders.
